entries.046ab7a0cba62f36: This work involves specialist goods and skills for preparing the setting of a funeral. It includes decorating altars with fresh flowers, digitally processing memorial portrait photographs, and performing angel care such as yukan, which cleanses the body of the deceased.
entries.0682afe6132243e0: This work involves preparing and managing places to house the deceased. One form is to partner with religious corporations and others to recruit buyers for, sell and manage cemeteries and ossuaries. Some companies also handle this together with sales of Buddhist altars and Buddhist ritual implements.
entries.110a593198cf5b69: This industry handles the series of tasks from holding a funeral when a person dies through to placing the remains in a grave or ossuary, along with the goods and services that support them. In addition to companies that undertake the funeral itself, companies that perform cremation, and companies that sell and manage cemeteries and ossuaries, specialist companies are involved at each stage of a funeral, such as floral altars, memorial portrait photographs, and yukan (washing and preparing the body). Some companies combine this with other businesses such as nursing care or hotels to support the end of a person's life.
entries.75569a10835a0889: This work involves undertaking and conducting funerals. Some companies handle everything from funeral consultation through the progress of the ceremony to memorial services, and some also carry out cremation themselves. There are also groups that bring together funeral companies in various regions in the form of a holding company.
